explanation: The numerator counts occupied seat-minutes and the denominator counts capacity seat-minutes over the same operated journeys with regular service.
queries:
SELECT CAST(SUM(j.occupied * j.minutes) AS TEXT) || '/' ||
       CAST(SUM(j.capacity * j.minutes) AS TEXT) AS occupancy
  FROM journeys AS j
  JOIN services AS s ON j.line_id = s.line_id
 WHERE j.state = 'operated' AND s.scope = 'regular'
HAVING SUM(j.capacity * j.minutes) > 0

explanation: Les charges sont converties en kg et les distances en m. La somme entière des kg·m est divisée exactement par un million pour obtenir des t·km.
queries:
WITH conversions AS (
    SELECT CASE u_charge WHEN 'kg' THEN charge WHEN 't' THEN charge * 1000 END AS kg,
           CASE u_trajet WHEN 'm' THEN trajet WHEN 'km' THEN trajet * 1000 END AS m
      FROM expeditions
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(kg * m) AS TEXT) || '/1000000' AS travail
  FROM conversions
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 AND COUNT(kg) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(m) = COUNT(*)

explanation: Mesure requise manquante pour piquet-5.duree_s. La puissance moyenne de tous les cycles est indéterminée.
queries:
SELECT cycle, 'duree_s' AS field FROM mesures WHERE duree_s IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT cycle, 'energie_j' AS field FROM mesures WHERE energie_j IS NULL
ORDER BY cycle, field
